New features
- Settings is easier to read: brighter text, softer switches, and tabs that look like buttons.
- The Keyboard shortcuts tab is now called Hotkeys.

history.notes:
New features
- Settings is easier to read: brighter text, softer switches, and tabs that look like buttons.
- The Keyboard shortcuts tab is now called Hotkeys.

New features
- A short note under the instrument explains that notes clicked on the instrument's own keyboard can't be brought back by MIDI Replay.

Issue fixes
- MIDI editor: the metronome now clicks on the editor's bars and beats while it plays or records.
- Imported MIDI files land exactly on their beats, and the app switches to the file's tempo.
- Changing the tempo keeps every note on its beat.
- With notes selected, ← / → move them to the next grid line.
- Simpler default shortcuts: MIDI Replay is Ctrl+P and Cut is Ctrl+X.
- Fixed: the app could keep running after being closed; custom keyboard layouts' octave keys changed after a restart; Export and Import MIDI didn't remember your last folder.

New features
- Audio input: play a microphone, guitar or any other input through the effects, with or without an instrument. Turn it on with the power button beside Input in Settings > Audio & MIDI.
- Settings has a new look, matching the toolbar.
- Choose how saved files are named in Settings > License & data.

Issue fixes
- The loop stays where you put it; with Loop off it shows as an outline you can still drag.
- Record starts playback by itself
- A note held all the way round the loop no longer merges into one long note.
- Pressing MIDI Replay keeps your view where it was.

New features
- Keyboard shortcuts tab in Settings: see every shortcut and change any of them.
- Drag a loop number up or down to move it a sixteenth at a time (hold Shift for fine steps); double-click the loop bar to turn Loop on or off.
- The scissors now keep just the loop: press once to see what goes, again to cut, or X to cancel.
- Click anywhere on the grid or ruler to move the playhead, even outside the loop.

Issue fixes
- While recording, notes appear the moment you play them.
- With Replace on, each pass replaces the last one cleanly.
- A key you hold is no longer cut off by a pattern note on the same key.

New features
- A loop bar on the ruler: drag its ends or the whole bar.
- The loop's start and end beside the Loop button: drag a number or double-click to type it.

New features
- Computer keyboard tab in Settings: one row or two rows, and which keys change the octave.

Issue fixes
- Pattern plugins stop when you press Stop.
- Tooltips no longer show twice.

New features
- Moving computers: Release license in Settings, then enter your code on the new one.
- Everything you make is kept in one folder (Documents\YBK AUDIO\Instrument Player).
- More than two octaves from the computer keyboard, or your own keys.
- Add your own plugin folders.
- MIDI editor: record over a looping pattern, MIDI Replay adds a new take after the pattern, and a reminder when closing with unsaved MIDI.
- Knobs on your MIDI controller move controls set with MIDI Learn (e.g. Serum 2).

New features
- Saved projects keep the MIDI editor's pattern too.

Issue fixes
- Updating no longer gets stuck on "Waiting for Instrument Player to finish closing", and quitting always fully closes the app.

New features
- Click the version number in the toolbar to see what changed and to update.

Issue fixes
- Settings: Factory reset moved to the bottom left, with OK at the bottom right, so the usual OK corner no longer resets the app.

Issue fixes
- Phrase players, arpeggiators and tempo-synced effects follow the toolbar's BPM instead of stopping after one note.

New features
- Take the instrument out with the x beside its name.
- Sort, reorder and hide plugins in the lists.

New features
- Projects: save the instrument, effects, tempo and volume as one file (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+O, or double-click it).
- Faster plugin scans that run in the background.

New features
- Pencil mode and more MIDI editor keys, an Audio Effects button, a fullscreen MIDI editor, and Factory reset in Settings.

Issue fixes
- Audio interfaces no longer click when used alongside a DAW at a different sample rate.

New features
- MIDI editor with capture and replay.
- Effects rack for effect plugins.
